player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Sauna and the Game room, repeatedly moving north and south without exploring the available east direction. I failed to recognize that I had not visited all reachable rooms and prematurely chose "DONE". Next time, I will prioritize exploring the east direction from the Sauna immediately. If I return to the Sauna later, I will check if the east path has been traversed before deciding to stop. I will only output "DONE" when I have visited every room reachable from the current graph and confirmed no new directions lead to unvisited nodes.
